title: Azure Key Vault and Secrets
description: Keep connection strings and certificates safe in Azure Key Vault and use them from ASP.NET Core.
longDescription: Hardcoded secrets are a common security risk. This module shows how to move secrets into Azure Key Vault, fetch them in C#, use managed identities to avoid credentials entirely, and integrate Key Vault with ASP.NET Core configuration.
whatYouLearn: Create and use Azure Key Vault secrets
Read secrets from C# using the Azure SDK
Use managed identities instead of connection strings
Wire Key Vault into ASP.NET Core configuration
